newsitem.title: USA: 3Com willing to trim margins for growth.
newsitem.headline: 3Com willing to trim margins for growth.

text.p: 3Com Corp will strive for growth in 1997 and is willing to forego growth in gross margins to get it, executive vice president Bob Finocchio said.

"We're going for as much growth as possible," Finocchio, also manager of 3Com's Network Systems Operations, told the Montgomery Securities Investment Conference. He said 3Com, like its competitors in the industry, believes "it is better to trade off gross margin for market share."
But Finocchio said 3Com won't let its gross margins fall.
"We will behave within our model of 52 percent to 54 percent," he said in an interview following his presentation.
3Com's share of the network equipment market ranks second to Cisco Systems Inc, but Finocchio said 3Com believes it "can get closer" to Cisco in 1997, which it enters with a strong new product cycle.

He said with its fast Ethernet products, called EtherLink XL and Fast EtherLink XL, 3Com is now the market leader, having overtaken Intel Corp's fast Ethernet product in the last few months. Intel had been the market leader.
Finocchio said 3Com now has about 45 percent market share with its fast Ethernet networking products.
